LOI_locator: Table 3, LOI row (journal p.165; PDF p.9)
TG_locator: TG Analysis of Nylon Fabric, explicit prose (journal pp.161-162; PDF pp.5-6); Figure 6 caption identifies all three fabric/wash states
conditions_locator: Experimental, Materials (p.158/PDF p.2); Fabric Treatment Procedure and Characterization (p.159/PDF p.3)
source_location: TG Analysis of Nylon Fabric, explicit prose (journal pp.161-162; PDF pp.5-6); Figure 6 caption identifies all three fabric/wash states; Table 3, LOI row (journal p.165; PDF p.9); Experimental, Materials (p.158/PDF p.2); Fabric Treatment Procedure and Characterization (p.159/PDF p.3)
numeric_evidence_detail: Tonset and terminal residue are author-stated exact prose numbers; LOI is Table 3. R600 and residue_temp_C intentionally blank because prose does not explicitly assign residue temperature, although methods and Figure 6 end at 600°C. No curve-derived value.
pairing_evidence: The TG Analysis of Nylon Fabric text and Figure 6 caption identify untreated, PA-FR treated, and treated after 10 launderings. Table 3 uses the same three specimen states. Characterization specifies TGA of samples and LOI on strips of nylon fabrics; finished fabric is distinct from separately characterized PA-FR finishing agent. The initial soap rinse is preparation and is not the extra 10-laundering state.
limitations: No TGA purge flow stated; 50 mL/min belongs to DSC and 171 mL/min belongs to LOI. Initial decomposition onset has no specified mass-loss percentage, so it is not T5/T10. Terminal residue temperature held rather than assumed. No LOI uncertainty reported. Do not use MCC Table 2 residues as TGA. Nylon subtype is not expressly established for substrate; PA66 is the synthesized finishing polymer. Exact protocol for additional 10 launderings not stated.
